name: daxuan-science-assets
review_cadence: After scientific or visual feedback, workflow or image-backend changes; otherwise quarterly
upstream_inspiration: Rimagination/scansci-svg; lgwrightlab/schematic-figure; K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills; qiaomu-meta-skill; daxuan-image-relay; skill-creator

intent.job_to_be_done: Create transparent native SVG scientific objects and source-traceable methodology schematics with editable parts, labels, relationships, and palette roles.
inputs: Optional reference image or existing SVG
Supplied papers, inspected methods, figures or supplements
Preliminary idea, proposed adaptation, and figure scope/size/detail budget
Reference-author colors and the destination figure, with explicit color meanings or author palette reports
outputs: Methodology semantic plan and source/evidence map when applicable
Verified local source extracts and reproducible base diagram when applicable
Color context, source snapshots and palette/contrast checks when reference or target colors matter
exclusions: Invented methods, mechanisms, citations or results

evidence_boundary.native_svg_tooling: Existing native vector tools and three bundled fixtures remain unchanged; source-selection and alpha checks are covered by current tests.
evidence_boundary.image_provider: One live active-relay gpt-image-2 generation returned HTTP 200 and a saved RGB reference PNG. Official live generation and relay edits remain untested.
evidence_boundary.publication: GitHub distribution v0.5.1; see publication-checks.json and the release-attached remote verification record.
evidence_boundary.trigger_routing: 28/28 English lexical smoke cases; not measured model-routing accuracy
evidence_boundary.local_install: Historical 0.5.0 installation remains in install-evidence.json; current publication installation is recorded in publication-checks.json.
evidence_boundary.methodology: One primary-paper excerpt-to-SVG example (Love et al., 2014), with verified local extract hashes and quotation containment, plus one authored idea fixture. Native output reproduces from the explicit plan; agent source/visual review only, not an independent scientific benchmark.
evidence_boundary.color_context: Local paint/raster inspection and color-decision checks pass 12 focused tests. A two-material local revision passes alpha, source, role-lock and geometry checks, with agent slot/full-figure inspection; no independent perception benchmark.
